from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the provided collection, including its title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
